notes: ARIA is now StorageGRID-aware. Active IQ exposes, per grid, the site/node topology (role, appliance model, RAID, drives, version), tenants and buckets (versioning, S3 Object Lock, CloudMirror) and ILM rules (placements, storage pools, ingest behaviour); ARIA previously harvested only capacity. Now harvested, analysed (single-site grid, single-copy/default ILM rules, no versioning or immutability, mixed node versions, support term, capacity) and reported in the GUI and every relevant deliverable.
